# Vallhund Cybernetics

> Vallhund Cybernetics is a commercial robotics engineering company in Fayetteville, North Carolina, and a trade name (DBA) of KEMET Holdings LLC. It builds embodied machine AI (50 Hz local ONNX policies and vision-language-action manipulation), dexterous manipulation hardware (VH-MICRO-HAND-3F 3-finger serial-bus hands), and multi-rail power systems (VH-PWR-2.0). Vallhund Microbots™ is its consumer desk-robotics line, home of the desk humanoids Boozy™ and Marshmallow™.

Mailing address: KEMET Holdings LLC, PO Box 25161, Fayetteville, NC 28314, USA.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vallhundcybernetics.com/): Commercial master plan. Stage 01 ships Vallhund Microbots™. Stage 02 is the hand, brain, and power stack. Stage 03 is concept architecture only.
- [Vallhund Microbots™ (Boozy™ & Marshmallow™)](https://vallhundcybernetics.com/microbots/): Consumer desk-robotics line of Vallhund Cybernetics. Small desk humanoids with VH-MICRO-HAND-3F hands, VH-PWR-2.0 3-rail power, and local 50 Hz ONNX embodied AI.
- [Founders & Contact](https://vallhundcybernetics.com/founders/): Founder and mailing address for Vallhund Cybernetics.
- [Vallhund arm, interactive 3D model](https://vallhundcybernetics.com/arm.html): the manipulation module in bench build.

## What exists today

- Vallhund Microbots™ (Boozy™ and Marshmallow™): shipping consumer desk humanoids and the live testbed for the hand, power, and 50 Hz ONNX stack. Status on the site: lab fabrication and waitlist / builder kits.
- Dexterous hands: VH-MICRO-HAND-3F 3-finger serial-bus hands, with a stated direction toward larger multi-DOF hands.
- Power: VH-PWR-2.0 isolated multi-rail architecture.
- The Vallhund arm: small robotic manipulation taught by demonstration. Status on the site: bench build.

## Concept architecture (not for sale, not in production)

- Full-scale home and workspace humanoid concept, scaling the Boozy™ / Marshmallow™ brain and hand stack.
- VH-MARLOW: autonomous utility quadruped concept for home, property, and commercial inspection.
- Telepresence and sensory cockpit concept: 50 Hz XR / head-tracked teleoperation and an imitation-learning pipeline.
